script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$L" --check stuck_detection eq true --check execution_status eq idle
control-agent-server conversation send "$L" --text 'hi' --no-run
control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$L" --name f05-l-stuck --duration 300
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$L/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true --save F05.stuck-detected/run
control-agent-server conversation wait "$L" --until stuck --timeout 60
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$L" --check execution_status eq stuck --save F05.stuck-detected/get
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/search --query status=stuck --check items len-eq 1 --check items.0.id eq "$L"
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --query status=stuck --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$L/events/count" --query kind=$ACTION_KIND --check . eq 4
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$L/events/count" --query kind=$OBSERVATION_KIND --check . eq 4
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$L/events/count" --query kind=$ERROR_KIND --check . eq 0
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f05-loop --expect-min 4 --expect-max 4
control-agent-server ws read f05-l-stuck --contains '"key": "full_state"' --expect-min 2 --wait 30
control-agent-server ws stop f05-l-stuck --contains '"key": "execution_status", "value": "stuck"' --save F05.stuck-detected/frames
control-agent-server ws read f05-l-stuck --kinds ConversationErrorEvent --expect-none
